item.title: I built a blog
item.description:
So I built this website. Using Hugo.

It was rather easy. I followed the instructions here to setup Hugo and this first page

This blog is hosted in github, using github actions. Hugo has a great documentation on how to do it here so I won’t repeat the same information.
